stem: Characteristic of the diplomat’s new book is the ____ relationship between the evidence adduced and the inferences drawn, the footnotes and citations teeming with ambiguity and complexity, while the summary statements are more dogmatic simplicities.

To function as (i)____, literary critics must write well. A badly written book review is worse than a badly written political speech or greeting card; a badly written review is (ii)____, like a barber with a terrible haircut. If critics cannot write well, how can they authoritatively recognize and promote good writing?

Genetic researchers have recently suggested that our political learnings may be determined by our DNA, a view that tends to undermine our reflective self-flattery. We (i)____ the idea that personal politics are entirely (ii)____. The genetic explanation for ideology (iii)____ our belief that we are persuaded only by rational arguments.

Jimi Hendrix was a pivotal figure in the visionary aesthetic movement known as Afrofuturism, which is steeped in African American musical tradition yet ____ technological innovation, from synthesizers to spaceships.
Sánchez’ novels have been praised for their remarkable ____, the way in which they so palpably represent a certain place and time.

Because previous experience in office tends to reveal the limits of a political candidate's power, we are often ____ candidates with little experience, blank slates onto which we can project our fantasies for change.
While Davy is regarded as a giant of early chemistry and was once known to every educated British school child, his mentor Beddoes is seen as a ____ figure, even by historians of medicine.
